title: Zuriel Chapter Introductions — 1 Kings 12–22 (Part 2)
description: Chapter-by-chapter studies following Solomon's reign, the divided kingdom, and the prophetic challenge to idolatry.

chapters.title: 1 Kings 12 — Solomon's wealth and splendour
chapters.historicalContext: The chapter catalogues Solomon's wealth, trade, and royal display.
chapters.overview: The chapter catalogues Solomon's wealth, trade, and royal display.
chapters.studyObservation: The accumulation of wealth foreshadows the tension between prosperity and the covenant's warnings about kings.
chapters.connectionNotes: Read 1 Kings 11–13 together to follow the surrounding sequence; connect the chapter with the larger covenant story from Deuteronomy and the Davidic promise in 2 Samuel 7.
studyQuestions: What decisions and events shape this chapter?
What does the account reveal about worship, leadership, justice, or covenant faithfulness?
Which voices or consequences deserve closer attention?
chapters.lifeApplication: Consider how this chapter shapes faithful worship, wise decisions, humility, justice, and responsibility. Apply its principles carefully without treating ancient royal or national circumstances as a direct command for today.
chapters.interpretiveCaution: Narrative descriptions of kings, wealth, conflict, and judgment are not automatic promises or formulas for every modern situation.
chapters.readingNote: Notice what the narrator explicitly says, distinguish description from approval, and read the chapter within the whole biblical storyline.
